ai_summary: Advait Energy Transitions Limited, via its material subsidiary, has secured a significant domestic turnkey EPC contract from KPI Green Energy Limited for a 200 MW solar project in Bikaner, Rajasthan. Valued at ₹116 Crores (excluding taxes) and to be executed within 12 months, this order is expected to materially boost the company's revenue and strengthen its position in the renewable energy EPC sector. No immediate red flags are apparent, with the transaction identified as a normal course of business and not a related party transaction.
